item.title: Visualization of Simulation Results - Athena++ Tutorial 4
item.description:
Introduction.

Visualization of 3D magnetohydrodynamic simulation results computed in parallel in this post. The visualization is done with VisIt 3.3.3 running on a Mac.

item.title: 3D Magnetohydrodynamic Simulation and Parallel Computing - Athena++ Tutorial 4
item.description:
Introduction

Up to this article posted last month, I have confirmed that OpenMPI can be embedded in a Docker container and used for parallel computing on multiple nodes. In this post, I will use the Docker container created above to run tutorial 4 “Running 3D MHD with OpenMP and MPI” of Athena++ on multiple nodes.

item.title: Run the Athena++ tutorial
item.description:
Introduction

In a previous post, I summarized the contents of the first tutorial “1D Hydorodynamics and MHD” after installing Athena++. This post is a continuation of that post and summarizes the contents of the tutorial that was executed to perform visualization and other tasks.
